svg.title: Надежные фоновые задания с YDB и YMQ
svg.desc: Архитектура отделяет прием бизнес-запроса от длительной фоновой работы.
svg.text: Надежные фоновые задания с YDB и YMQ
External producer, relays and workers · two YDB transactions · explicit YMQ claim and ack
YMQ → Worker: claim/receive with visibility; Worker → YMQ: ack/delete only after commit.
No ack or visibility expiry causes retry; retry limit redrives the message to DLQ.
CDC creates one change record per committed row change; reading and processing may repeat.
Status Topic uses producer_id = message_group_id = job_id; order is within producer_id.
Queue delivery and external effects are not exactly-once processing.
